artifact_observations.reasoning: The hair lacks individual strand definition. It appears as smooth, plastic-like clumps rather than distinct fibers. This 'melting' of strands into solid shapes is a common AI artifact in hair generation.

The transition between the wig and the forehead is slightly blurry and indistinct. There is no clear lace front or natural hairline; the hair seems to emerge directly from the skin without a logical boundary.
The curls on the right edge seem to flatten and merge with the background slightly, lacking the depth consistency seen in the center.
